title: Coral Tide Sub
description: A deep, round reggaeton sub bass rooted in a sine core with subtle FM warmth riding a dembow-flavored stepped pitch arc. Slow ladder-filter breathing, a gentle vibrato swell, and a softly saturated gain travel keep the sub alive across a 32-cycle morph loop — clean enough to sit under any groove, deep enough to shake the floor.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 2.2)).fmh("<1 1 1.5 0.5>/8")
    .penv("<0 0 12 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.08)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(180, 1100)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(3, 10)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib(sine.slow(31).range(0.1, 0.6)).vibmod(0.4)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.08, 0.28)).crush("<14 14 12 10>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.38, 0.62))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.7).hpf(400))
    .room(0.12).gain(0.88)
)
